business_summary: Nantong Xingqiu Graphite Co.,Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, sale, and maintenance of graphite equipment in China and internationally. The company offers graphite heat exchangers, absorbers, column, storage tanks, and tube and fittings; silicon carbide equipment; graphite products, aluminum foil specialized electrode plates, and metal sodium electric energy anode plates; and graphite synthesis furnaces, graphite reactors and towers, and corrosion-resistant equipment, as well as integrated system solutions, including by-product steam hydrogen chloride graphite synthesis, multi-effect evaporation, hydrochloric acid desorption, molecular sieve drying, sulfuric acid concentration and drying system, phosphoric acid concentration, hydrochloric acid and sulfuric acid dechlorination, and hydrogen chloride silicon tetrachloride drying system. It also provides maintenance and repair services, and technical consultancy services. Its products are used in caustic soda, inorganic acid and inorganic industrial drugs, metallurgy and metal surface treatment, petroleum, resin and fiber, other organic synthesis, pharmaceuticals, pesticides, food, public hazards, and safety equipment industries. The company was formerly known as Nantong Xingxing Graphite Equipment Co., Ltd. Nantong Xingqiu Graphite Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1987 and is headquartered in Rugao, China.
